step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts and open the agreement document.

Extract data from the document using Contract Intelligence by clicking Review Import Results. For more information on data extraction, see Extracting Agreement Data Using Contract Intelligence for CLM.
In the Contracts pane, click the Work tab and click Doc Clauses. The list of extracted doc clauses is displayed.

Select the clause that has been incorrectly tagged as a clause. To return it to untagged plain text, click the More button(), and click Unmark. A confirmation dialog appears. This unmarks the doc clause that was extracted and retains the clause content as plain text.
